# Kebra (YC S26)

Kebra (YC S26) is a Artificial Intelligence company. Kebra is an AI company that helps AI agents document every job, recover warranty revenue, and run back office operations. Kebra (YC S26) employs 2 people, founded in 2026. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, United States.

## About

Kebra guides technicians in the field in real time, documents their job, and automatically handles hours of back-office work; from dispatching to filing warranty claims and managing inventory.

Backed by Y Combinator, SV Angel, Browder Capital, Founders Future, and a group of incredible angels

- Industry: Artificial Intelligence
